problem:
Which of the following matrices are transformed into the $3\times 3$ identity matrix after applying the row operations ${R}_{2}:={R}_{2}+7{R}_{1}\,$ and $\,{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-2){R}_{2}?$

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 7 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ -7 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 7 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$
